Absolutely divine!
Oct 2025 • Family
We came here two nights in a row and our only regret is that we didn’t find this place sooner! The atmosphere and food are both really special - but the staff and the service especially from Noah was very attentive and warm and we couldn’t recommend enough! We would highly recommend the pumpkin soup and sorrento ham and burrata on toast as well as the chocolate lava cake - but all of it was beautifully presented and tasted gorgeous. The cocktails were top notch and were as good as they looked and the music taste was also great! Thank you so much :)

Delicious Tapas in D1!
Feb 2025 • Couples
Amazing dinner! This gem was just around the corner from our Airbnb, so we decided to try it, and so glad we did! We arrived late (shortly after 9:00 pm), so the restaurant was almost empty, but decided to stay based on reviews, and it did NOT disappoint.  After traveling in Vietnam for 2.5 weeks, we were craving something different.  We had an amazing meal of tapas and absolutely delicious white sangria! The price was reasonable for 3 sangrias, and 5 tapas plates, it was about 1.2 MM VND, that also includes the VAT and service charge. The service was impeccable as well. Would highly recommended this amazing restaurant!
